The prior record's five logged axes (compound X+Z, compound Z only, split vx declaration, direct vel[0] with a later vx cache, compound X with an inline absolute-X ternary) were NOT re-run: all are recorded, three of them negative on the X web specifically.
attributes.residual: CAPPED, no change retained, and the prior record's BASELINE IS CORRECTED. Remeasured baseline is real 104 (insns T107/O107, multiset 2t), not the real 106 attempt.slidealongwall-compound-z-reload.20260831.v1 banked as its best -- the function improved by 2 since that record was written, so its numbers were stale and any future probe must re-derive rather than trust them. MECHANISM, unchanged and now named exactly: multiset DIFFERS by target-only +1 lfs against ours-only -1 fmr. Target loads vel[0] TWICE (at 0x1c, at its first use inside the pen expression, and again at 0xf0 for the absolute-value chain); ours loads it once at entry (because `f32 vx = vel[0];` is an entry local) and pays an `fmr` at 0x18 to keep a second copy live. Pure reload-vs-cache, on the X web only -- the prior pass already won the Z side with `vel[2] -= dotz`. C1'S REFUTATION IS THE DURABLE FINDING: the `volatile` on WZERO64 is NOT removable scaffolding. With it, our four separate pool reads match target's count exactly; without it MWCC CSEs them into a single load and DELETES FOUR `lfd`, so the qualifier is precisely what reproduces target's per-comparison re-read of the f64 zero. It must be preserved in this TU. DO NOT RETRY: de-volatilising WZERO64 or WZERO32, and the three X-web forms the prior record killed. NEXT AGENT: the only untried lever left on the X web is to stop `vx` being an entry local entirely -- read `vel[0]` directly inside the pen expression AND read it again into `vx` at the absolute-value chain, with no cache in between, which is a different form from the prior record's axis 4 (that one kept a later vx cache and measured real 120).
